profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior-focused Cloud-Native Software Engineer   
5 years of experience building, scaling, and maintaining high-availability enterprise platforms.  

Broadcom: Architecting Tanzu Hub UIs (Angular/GraphQL) and optimizing container-to-container networking for Tanzu Platform.  

VMware (Tanzu Labs): Guided Fortune 500 clients (CVS, Verizon) through cloud-native modernizations, including validating high-throughput systems at ~15,000 messages/sec.  

USMC Veteran: Ex-Flight Equipment Technician bringing disciplined execution to high-pressure production troubleshooting and operational excellence.
